plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: test "$(cat dist/VERSION)" = '${nextRelease.version}' && sh scripts/verdict.sh go-major node scripts/go-major.mjs '${nextRelease.version}'

plugins.publishCmd: sh scripts/verdict.sh npm-publish node scripts/npm-publish.mjs && sh scripts/verdict.sh npm-publish node scripts/npm-publish.mjs --dir dist/npm-next --tag next
